evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random.
